note: Copilot & AI #9. ask, siteai and skills-page need a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence on labadmin (owner decision, not bought); without it record what labadmin sees and say so. Do not create a spending policy, do not connect SharePoint agents billing, do not accept a prompt that spends Copilot Credits. A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT) { $env:MG_TENANT = Read-Host 'Lab tenant short name (owner types, never shown)' }
if (-not $env:PNP_CLIENT_ID) { $env:PNP_CLIENT_ID = Read-Host 'PnP app client id, MGLab PnP (owner types, never shown)' }
# manual (owner): the site contoso-vmo (libraries Policies and Restricted) from episode 3 must exist; re-create it with episode 3 New-VendorKnowledgeSite.ps1 if it was torn down

# manual (owner, only with the licence): assign one Microsoft 365 Copilot seat to labadmin, wait until the Copilot button shows on the site; two sample vendor requests as .docx in Policies (one complete: security, 12,000 euros a year; one with no justification and 30,000 euros a year)
# manual (owner): only if the tenant still creates .agent files, create the three sample agents (Vendor Desk, Renewals Helper, one on another site) with a few views each

screens.name: copilot-sharepoint
steps: Open the site contoso-vmo, Policies library, as labadmin
Open Copilot (needs the Microsoft 365 Copilot licence) and ask: Which vendor requests above 25,000 euros need a security review, and who approves them?
Expected: finance director after a security review, from the onboarding policy; show the citations
Without the licence record what labadmin sees instead (no Copilot button) and say so; optional second take as sam.demo
mask: tenant name in the address bar and site URL

screens.name: site-ai
steps: Show the three options: which agent opens from the header (Copilot in SharePoint or a custom agent), hide the Copilot button for visitors, advanced document processing
Change nothing and do not turn on advanced document processing (it can use credits)
If the panel is missing record that and note the licence state
mask: tenant name in the address bar and site URL

screens.name: inventory
mask: tenant URL and client id are passed from the environment and never typed
no tenant URL in the output
screens.note: The PnP interactive sign-in (labadmin) is done by the owner in the browser. If there are no .agent files the real output is the 'No .agent files visible to you' line: record it and say so, do not fabricate files.

screens.name: site-skills
steps: Settings gear, Site skills, Create or upload, Upload: choose src\skills\vendor-intake-check\SKILL.md from the episode folder
Show the skill in the list as enabled (name, source, status); if Upload rejects the file record the message
In Policies select the two sample vendor requests and ask Copilot: Run vendor-intake-check on the selected documents
Record the real answer and the Vendor intake issues list it creates; if Copilot asks to spend Copilot Credits decline and record the prompt
mask: tenant name in the address bar and site URL
Windows user name in the file picker path

screens.name: admin-agents
steps: Microsoft 365 admin center, Copilot, Billing & usage, Pay-as-you-go services, Connect a service
Show SharePoint agents in the list; do NOT connect it and do not create a policy
Then open Agents (Copilot Control System), the inventory of agents used in Copilot Chat; read only
Record empty states or missing pages as they are
mask: tenant name in the top bar and address bar

teardown: # manual (owner): remove the Copilot seat from labadmin and cancel or let the purchase lapse as decided; disable or delete the vendor-intake-check site skill, the Vendor intake issues list, the two sample requests and any .agent files created (empty the recycle bin)

# manual (owner): if the VMO site was created only for this episode remove it with episode 3 New-VendorKnowledgeSite.ps1 -Remove; delete the Entra app registration MGLab PnP and browser sign-ins not needed
